backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a leaderboard and mission system with functions to submit/retrieve scores by game mode and add/update/query missions with progress tracking and rewards.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short descriptions of each frontend source file, summarizing their roles in the TetrisVerse game application.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the TetrisVerse frontend, mounting the React app at the #root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/public/app-ads.txt: Google AdMob app-ads.txt verification file declaring the publisher ID for TetrisVerse's direct ad relationship.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that renders only the LandingPage component with no additional providers or game logic.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Static landing page for the TetrisVerse developer site, displaying the app logo, AdMob verification info, a link to app-ads.txt, and a privacy policy section.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage with optional access control initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity authentication hook and provider implementing login/logout flows using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing identity state and status via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file reserved for future backend query integrations; currently contains no functional code.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for a dark neon-themed game UI, including color tokens for backgrounds, cards, borders, and neon accent colors, plus a glow-pulse animation utility.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those parameters via sessionStorage and history.replaceState.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom fonts, CSS-variable-based color tokens (including game-specific neon colors), border radii, spacing, and custom keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for TetrisVerse tracking schema version, known issues (unintended v47 deploy), and two pending feature requests to add an app-ads.txt file at the /app-ads.txt path without other changes.
